scope: Final PV generation inputs and prepared resource/spatial figure inputs
final_accounting_assumption: CCU/DAC FT and MTJ use the shared configured route-level 7.6 kWh/kg final fuel input

input_levels.pv_rebuild: build_pv_inputs.py consumes the original source-compute selected inputs, phase mapping, retained HDF5 coordinate extract and original twelve-week resource table; final frozen inputs are separately retained.
input_levels.resource_replot: The reproducibility_source entries accept explicit workspace, external-project, PV, legacy-template and output paths. The original executed sources and their hashes are separately retained. The selected genuine wind files retain their original names and lexicographic sampling order.
input_levels.spatial_replot: The final network_data, templates and final temporal/CI records are the complete prepared rendering inputs. Mass-flow metric CSVs retain genuine model distances; route geometry is explicitly endpoint-only.
input_levels.upstream_network_rebuild: Original verified model exports, final accounts and authentic routing cache are retained by the main execution archive; build_inputs.py records that upstream interface.

runtime.cartographic_data: frykit_data package 0.0.1 for resource maps; spatial maps retain the original raster basemap

portable_entries.pv: reproducibility_source/build_pv_inputs.py --source-compute OLD_COMPUTE --raw-solar RAW_EXTRACT --source-twelve-weeks OLD_12W --parameters PV_PARAMETERS --output NEW_PV
portable_entries.resource_s9_s10: reproducibility_source/redraw_s9_s10.py --workspace-root WORKSPACE --pv-inputs PV --legacy-figures LEGACY --external-project EXTERNAL_PROJECT --output-root OUTPUT
portable_entries.spatial: reproducibility_source/render_spatial.py --workspace-root WORKSPACE --legacy-figures LEGACY --external-project MODEL_PROJECT --accounting-root ACCOUNTS --data NETWORK_DATA --templates TEMPLATES --output OUTPUT --temporal-data TEMPORAL_DATA --temporal-inputs TEMPORAL_INPUTS; reproduce the final standalone S26 invocation in a fresh process by adding --joint-only after the full render
